title: BitHab
tagline: BitHab helps build sustainable habits via a lightweight, client-side dashboard.
description: BitHab helps build sustainable habits via a lightweight, client-side dashboard. Track activities, goals, reminders, and notes to reinforce daily consistency. Features responsive themes, Firebase sync, and easy static deployment. Includes a progress calendar, streak indicators, goal coloring, auto-saving notes, a focused work mode, and insights.
